lesson: Product and the product life cycle
title: The product life cycle and an extension strategy
caption: Sales are low at introduction, rise in growth, peak in maturity and fall in decline. An extension strategy, such as the Lucozade relaunch, lifts sales again instead of letting them fall.
alt: Sales against time in four stages: introduction, growth, maturity, decline. A dashed second curve shows an extension strategy lifting sales late in maturity, so sales do not decline.
description: Introduction: low sales and often losses.
Maturity: sales peak and competition is intense.
Extension strategies in maturity (new uses, new markets, modifications, repackaging, promotion) keep sales above the declining curve.
